beats.lead: Google began as a campus problem
beats.text: Its first version, BackRub, used nearly half of Stanford's network bandwidth.
beats.note: It was released on the university website in August 1996.

beats.name: Larry Page and Sergey Brin
beats.role: Stanford PhD students who started the BackRub research project.

beats.text: Andy Bechtolsheim wrote one for $100,000 in August 1998.
beats.note: It was made out to a corporation that did not yet exist.

beats.text: Google was incorporated on 4 September 1998 in a friend's garage.
beats.note: The garage belonged to Susan Wojcicki in Menlo Park.

beats.text: The company was funded before it was formed.

beats.line: Big things start as bandwidth problems.
